title: 'Complete system reset' needed to get 440,000 young people into work, says major review
description: Alan Milburn's review will call for sweeping reforms to the education, work and welfare systems.

title: Robert Pattinson to replace Daniel Craig as James Bond
description: The 40-year old is best known for his role in films including Twilight, The Batman and The Odyssey.

title: Cass report author says she does not support draft conversion practices bill
description: The gender care review author says the bill’s wording risks "serious unintended consequences" for parents and therapists.

title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
description: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

title: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial next year for deaths of her three children
description: The 36-year-old's first trial this year fell apart when a 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.

title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
description: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
description: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham says ahead of EU summit
description: The prime minister tells an audience at the Lord Mayor's Banquet that the "Brexit we were given has not worked".

title: Emma Barnett to leave Radio 4's Today for new BBC show
description: Barnett, who has presented Today and Woman's Hour, will front a multiplatform show in the New Year.
